output.subject: We've received your complaint about overdraft fees from 9/18
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us and for taking the time to explain your concerns. We want to confirm that we have received your complaint, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

You told us that you were charged four overdraft fees, totaling $136, on 9/18. You explained that a larger debit of $612.88 posted ahead of four smaller debit card purchases from the same day. You mentioned that those smaller purchases were made earlier in the day and, in your view, would not have overdrawn your account if they had posted in the order you made them. You also shared your concern that the posting order is designed to maximize fees. You have asked us to refund the four fees and to review how the transactions were posted.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint, and we will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer says they have already consulted an attorney; check whether legal should review before sending and whether the reply should acknowledge this.
Confirm the specialist team handling this and that a response within 10 business days is achievable.
Representative explained posting order per the deposit agreement on the call; the customer was not satisfied. The draft takes no position on this.
Customer requests a refund of four overdraft fees ($136) and a review of the posting order; outcome to be decided.
Verify the dates, the $612.88 amount, the number of transactions and the fee total against account records.
Case was escalated to a supervisor during the call; confirm the supervisor review status.
